# CIRCLE

CIRCLE is a free community for creators, freelancers, service providers, and brands, operated by Portfolix Enterprise Pvt Ltd in Kochi, India, with Portfolix.Media and Portfolix.Tech.

This file lists public pages. It is not a ranking signal and it does not replace the HTML pages.

Membership is free. CIRCLE does not process collab payments in v1. The brand pays the creator directly. Follower counts are labelled self-reported until verified. Contact: info@circlecommunity.in
